title: Lightly Spiced Middle Eastern Chickpeas Falafel
description: A yeasty, tender, and indulgent Middle Eastern dish featuring sweet smoked paprika, this falafel recipe is perfect for those looking for a flavorful and onion-free option. The fermentation process gives it a unique taste and texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chickpeas, sweet smoked paprika, yeast, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the lemon juice and olive oil to the bowl and stir until the chickpeas are evenly coated.
Let the mixture sit at room temperature for 24 hours to allow the yeast to ferment.
After the fermentation process, add the chickpea flour and water to the bowl and mix until a thick batter forms.
Using your hands, shape the batter into small falafel patties.
Heat about 2-3 inches of olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees.
Carefully place the falafel patties in the hot oil and fry for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the falafel from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the falafel hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
